\begin{document}
\begin{lemma}\label{lem:paving}
Every graph Laplacian admits an $r$-paving.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
This is the Marcus--Spielman--Srivastava theorem \cite{mss2015}.
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:average}
Some part has size at least $|V|/r$.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Pigeonhole on the $r$ parts.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:main}
There is $c>0$ with an $\varepsilon$-light subset of size $\ge c\varepsilon|V|$.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Apply \ref{lem:paving} to obtain the partition, then \ref{lem:average}
gives a large part. Combining these yields the bound.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
